quick_start.input_format: Three adult identities remain present and distinct. + All locations lie on one plausible continuous route. + Each prop passes through one visible social handoff. + Only one local discovery is emphasized at a time. + The group visibly recombines and resumes travel.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow three adult printmakers through one covered riverside market while one cobalt tote identifies the group. A sample card passes from vendor to first adult, then to the second for one tactile inspection. All three leave with the tote and seal visible, reform their walking line and continue toward the river.
